english: Interviews (and oral exams) will be held for the 2027 academic year university early admissions (수시모집, rolling admissions) through the General Admission (일반전형), Regional Balance Admission (지역균형전형) and Opportunity Balance Special Admission (기회균형특별전형). For this reason, classes will be cancelled and access to buildings will be restricted as shown below.
Please cooperate fully so that the early admissions process can run smoothly.
A. Class cancellations and building access restrictions

- Classes cancelled: 26 Nov 2026 (Thu) 09:00 ~ 27 Nov (Fri) 20:00
- Courses cancelled: all courses offered by the College of Engineering (make-up classes must be held)
- Access restricted: all of Building 302 (1 building)
※ Building 302 can be entered after 8 p.m. on 27 Nov (Fri)

Regional Balance Admission and
Opportunity Balance Special Admission
4 Dec 2026 (Fri)

- Classes cancelled: 3 Dec 2026 (Thu) 09:00 ~ 4 Dec (Fri) 20:00
- Courses cancelled: courses taught by interviewers and all courses held in Building 39 (make-up classes must be held)
- Access restricted: all of Building 39 (1 building)
※ Building 39 can be entered after 8 p.m. on 4 Dec (Fri)
※ During these periods, only people involved in the exams may enter the exam areas (lecture rooms, professors' offices, seminar rooms, meeting rooms, etc.) in the restricted buildings.
※ Offices (department/school and major offices, etc.) will operate as usual (staff will work as normal).
